text:
miranda: Quick sync — customer feedback from three pilots shows strong demand for (1) per-tenant audit partitioning, (2) BYOK with escrow opt-in, and (3) long-tail retention (up to 7 years). Can we triage into sprint buckets? Spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/enterprise-signal :eyes:

ajay: For FinServ pilot BYOK is non-negotiable. We should treat escrow as a separate legal+ops integration — that will be heavier. Also flag: retention affects encryption key rotation and HSM requirements.

sam: Per-tenant partitioning (logical separation + per-tenant indexes) looks straightforward conceptually but will change ingestion path and index sharding. Rough back-of-envelope: 2 engineers 3 weeks for MVP (no fancy search on cold data).

laura: Escrow requires contract language about access conditions, jurisdiction, and retention triggers. I can draft a clause but need product to define: who can request escrow releases and audit trail requirements.

toni: Customer success tally: 5 pilot customers specifically asked for 7yr retention, 2 asked for region-specific retention rules. Price sensitivity: 3 explicitly expect us to charge for long-term storage.

ethan: From field eng: BYOK onboarding calls currently take ~2 hours per tenant for the handshake. We can streamline with a guided console flow + API, but that's an extra UX ticket.

miranda: Proposed split for prioritization (keep it opinionated):
- Sprint A (next): per-tenant audit partitioning (MVP: isolated index + per-tenant metadata), 90-day search hot path, retention TTL hooks to cold archive.
- Sprint B: BYOK onboarding UX + API, BYOK verification + rotation docs, limited escrow pilot (manual ops).
- Sprint C: GA escrow integration (KMS provider bindings), multi-region retention policies, and SOC2/ISO evidence packaging work.

sam: Technical risks to call out: prefix caching invalidation when routing per-tenant, potential read amplification for cross-tenant aggregated queries, and storage growth rates for 7yr retention. Need perf baseline before we commit to latency SLOs.

ajay: Security asks: threat model for BYOK (key import, rotation, emergency revoke), audit trail for escrow releases, proof of deletion for long-term retention. I can own threat model doc.

laura: Legal asks product to define access semantics before I finalize clauses. Also we need to decide whether escrow access requires court order or customer-signed release; that impacts operations.

miranda: Quick prioritization matrix (one-liner):
- Must for FinServ pilot: BYOK onboarding + per-tenant audit partitioning.
- High: 7yr retention configurable as paid add-on with cold archive query SLA.
- Medium: automated escrow (manual pilot first).
- Low: cross-tenant aggregated search over cold archive.

ethan: Suggestion: add a "signal" tag in backlog items: PRODUCT-SIGNAL:FinServ / PRODUCT-SIGNAL:Healthcare so we can sort by revenue impact.

toni: +1. Also request a simple cost estimate line item for sales to use (e.g., incremental $/GiB/mo for cold storage + retrieval).

ops-bot: Reminder: Compliance sync meeting scheduled Wed 13:00 UTC — RSVP required.

miranda: Action items: @sam draft perf baseline and storage growth projection by Tuesday, @ajay own threat model, @laura provide escrow access options and wording, @toni produce customer pricing note. I'll update the roadmap doc and the short decision memo for Thursday's leadership review. :white_check_mark:

sam: Ack — will start perf tests on staging with 4 tenants and seeded 7yr retention sim.

ajay: I'll start threat model + checklist for BYOK escrow.

laura: Will prep two contract options (court-order vs customer-authorized release) and highlight legal risk differences.

toni: Will compile the customer asks into one slide and a draft quote template.

miranda: Thanks everyone — we'll use this thread as the single source for sprint scoping. If anyone gets new customer commitments, drop them here. :rocket:
